source_semantics.identity: The canonical Guid job id maps to the existing Laravel operation_executions.correlation_id exposed by EnqueueExternal as job_id; the internal numeric row id is never accepted as the canonical identifier.
source_semantics.selection: For the requested owner, TryStartExternal changes only an External execution currently Waiting and returns whether exactly one row changed.
source_semantics.state_transition: Waiting maps to queued and Running maps to running; a successful start sets started_at to now and clears completed_at and failure without manufacturing progress or processed-item changes.
source_semantics.activity: Exactly one Info activity with message Approved change execution started. is appended only when the state transition succeeds.

laravel_adaptation.ledger_mapping: The operation reuses the tenant-owned operation_executions and operation_logs control plane established by ExecutionCenterService.EnqueueExternal; no second execution ledger is introduced.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_owner_scope: The active TenantContext supplies tenant identity; operations.manage is authorized server-side; the active membership user must equal ownerUserId; the row lookup repeats tenant_id, canonical correlation_id and requested_by_user_id constraints under a transaction row lock.
laravel_adaptation.external_mode_mapping: Canonical ExecutionMode.External is preserved in operation_executions.payload.execution_mode and is required before starting.
laravel_adaptation.state_mapping: Canonical Waiting/Running map to queued/running. A successful transition sets started_at, clears completed_at and failure, and leaves progress, attempts and payload work counters unchanged.
laravel_adaptation.activity_mapping: A successful transition writes exactly one info operation_log with source ExecutionCenterService.TryStartExternal and operation ID AIMW-AUTO-8836C7A28A; missing, duplicate or ineligible starts write no activity.
laravel_adaptation.external_runtime_boundary: This adapter records the control-plane start state only and does not execute or claim WordPress/provider work.

proofs: exact canonical service/domain/source/member and operation ID AIMW-AUTO-8836C7A28A
canonical Guid job identity is preserved through correlation_id/job_id rather than the internal numeric row id
only queued External rows owned by the active tenant membership transition to running
successful start sets started_at and clears completed_at/failure without synthetic progress
exactly one canonical Info start activity is created and duplicate start cannot append another
missing, already-running and non-External rows safely return false without activity
wrong owner and missing operations.manage authorization fail closed
foreign-tenant execution/log rows are explicitly absent from the active tenant view and the authoritative owner row remains unchanged
missing TenantContext and invalid typed identity fail closed before persistence
acceptance.external_runtime: No live WordPress/provider/email/payment/DNS/manual evidence is required: TryStartExternal changes only local execution-control metadata and explicitly does not perform the external operation.
